actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: seed

facts.text: Env01 is registered as Env01-v1 with max_episode_steps=4000 and reward_threshold=6000
The action space is a Box of six floats, each from -1.0 to 1.0
One action component scales the joint motion by JOINT_STEP_SCALE = 0.075
A step adds the scaled action to each joint angle, writes the result to the position actuator ctrl and integrates the MuJoCo model frame_skip times
The observation is fifteen numbers: six joint angles, the block-to-end-effector deltas dx, dy and dz, the block position and the end-effector position
The observation space bounds the six joints by the model ranges and the remaining nine values by -1 to 1 and -0.5 to 0.5
The joint ranges are Rotation -2.2 to 2.2, Pitch -3.14158 to 0.2, Elbow 0 to 3.14158, Wrist_Pitch -2.0 to 1.8, Wrist_Roll -3.14158 to 3.14158 and Jaw -0.2 to 2.0 radians
The position actuators use kp=50, dampratio=1 and a force range of -35 to 35
Reset draws the block at a distance of 0.18 to 0.42 m from the base and within 0.25*pi of -0.5*pi in angle
Reset chooses one of 36 start poses from VALID_START_POSITIONS (six joint angles each)
Reset draws from numpy's global generator (np.random.uniform and np.random.randint), not from the environment's seeded np_random
Env01.step always reports terminated=False; the 4000-step TimeLimit wrapper is the only truncation
The reward combines a block-to-end-effector distance term, joint-range penalties and previous-step positions
The scene attaches the so_arm100 model and adds a free-joint block_a and a floor
Contacts between block_a and every arm body are excluded, so the arm never pushes the block
The scene does not set a MuJoCo timestep: its option timestep line is commented out

determinism.notes: the upstream reset_model draws the block position and the start pose from numpy's global generator (env01_v1.py:45-55), which gymnasium's reset(seed=...) does not seed, so the upstream model varies run to run; the package's fake backend seeds its own stand-in with random.Random(seed) and repeats a trajectory, but that is a property of the test data, not of the upstream model

gaps: the fake backend is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in: it models joint increments, a simple forward kinematics end effector and a distance reward, not MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics, contacts, gravity or the position actuators; it was never compared with the upstream environment (mujoco and gymnasium were not importable where the gate ran)
the upstream reset uses numpy's global generator, so the same seed does not repeat a trajectory on the sim backend; seed control is a property of the fake only, and the contract is statistical
contacts between block_a and every arm body are excluded (env01.xml:42-49): the block is a position indicator that the arm never pushes or grasps
the fake uses six representative rows of the clone's 36 VALID_START_POSITIONS (utils.py:13-50), so its reset start poses are a subset, and its forward kinematics and reward are stand-ins
no actuator, sensor or noise model is represented by the fake; the model's position actuators (kp=50, dampratio=1, forcerange -35..35) are not simulated

the timestep is 32 ms from frame_skip 16 (env_base_01.py:45) times MuJoCo's default 0.002 s; the scene leaves option timestep commented out (env01.xml:3) and the upstream path was not run to measure it
no rendering: Env01 renders only for a human viewer; the observation is the fifteen-number vector of _get_obs, and the Env03-Env05 offscreen camera paths are not served
snapshot and restore are not offered: Env01 exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
